title_zh: 韦朝晖：加快推动张怀桂世界级旅游廊道建设 持续推进文旅产业高质量发展
title_en: Wei Zhaohui: Accelerate Building the Zhangjiajie-Huaihua-Guilin World-Class Tourism Corridor and Advance High-Quality Cultural Tourism Development
summary_zh: 10月26日下午，2026年怀化市文化旅游高质量发展暨产业招商会在辰溪县孝坪镇召开，韦朝晖提出加快推动张怀桂世界级旅游廊道建设。
summary_en: Huaihua held its 2026 cultural tourism development and investment conference in Chenxi County on Oct 26, where Wei Zhaohui urged faster building of the Zhangjiajie-Huaihua-Guilin world-class tourism corridor.
body_zh:
韦朝晖：加快推动张怀桂世界级旅游廊道建设 持续推进文旅产业高质量发展
